title: Har Aza Khane Me Hai
body:
Har aza khane me hai
[Ya hussain, ya hussain] ×4
[Har azaa khane me hai matam bapaa Shabbir ka] ×2
(Hai zami(n) se asman tak) x2 tazkira Shabbir ka
[Asre ashoora jab aayi rehgaye tanha Hussain] ×2
